title: runstate's maintenance control-arm fixture fails on this host at base (already drafted as finding 4a5552730648)
body: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo (internal/runstate/maintenance_test.go) fails at the base commit on this host: a plain `git fetch` in the armed repository starts no maintenance, so the fixture proves nothing here. This is the same host-dependent fixture already drafted from jlv try 1 (key 4a5552730648) — repeated here because it is the only full-suite failure this attempt saw; it deduplicates against the standing draft.
